facts.value: The hobby-retailer association's directory lists 340 independent model-railroad and hobby shops; each takes estate collections on consignment every month.
Sell Estate-collection consignment appraisal workbook for model-railroad and hobby shops to each buyer.
Owners of independent model-railroad and hobby shops
The owner says hobby-shop owners would pay $250 for the workbook.

reviews.reasons: NO_PLAN is the right stance and names the decisive gap correctly. The single opening (cop_6c113dc4434d45cfb9c2) has reach (340-shop association directory), current demand (signal 2026-11-25), conversion measured on this offer's own sales (12/90 = 13.3%), Brain fulfilment (PRODUCE_SPREADSHEET), $5 cost, $0 exposure and 3 days to cash all on EVIDENCE. The only price is a PERSON fact: the owner says shops 'would pay $250'. That is someone's word, not a purchase price, so OFFER_AND_PRICE is unestablished and the revenue per deal — hence whether $2,500 is reachable — cannot be computed from evidence (Brain's planner agrees: 'price 250 USD is a guess'). The plan does not treat the $250 as known, records no ledger, and names OFFER_AND_PRICE as the decisive link with a concrete resolution: the price on the 12 existing paid orders, or a published dated price. If $250 were confirmed, ceil(2500/250) = 10 deals (11 with Brain's margin) against 340 x 0.133 = ~45 expected orders, settling in 3 days, would make it EXECUTABLE — so price is the only thing standing between this and a plan.
findings: Price defect: the $250 is PERSON_WORD (owner's statement), not a purchase record; correctly not used.

The 12 paid orders recorded in conversionRates imply a price was actually paid on each; retrieving those order/payment records is the cheapest resolution and the plan's research step r1 targets it first.

Brain's MARKET_VOLUME basis treats each shop as buying every 30 days because shops take estate collections monthly; a workbook is plausibly a one-time purchase per shop, but within a single 30-day window this still gives at most one purchase per shop (340 available), so it does not affect sufficiency.

Stance check: this is not CONDITIONAL — the missing fact is an existing record that research can retrieve, not an unknown only a live test can measure; and no constraint is claimed, correctly, since the gap is missing evidence rather than a limit the evidence cannot fit.
